## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Energy/Healthcare/Staples are outperforming while Technology and Financials are mixed, and leadership is broad (Top 5 span 4 sectors), supporting a neutral, balanced posture.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.44%). Healthcare and Consumer Staples are also positive with UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) and PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak with CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%), Consumer Discretionary soft with HD BELOW TREND (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -11.76%) and BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%), and Real Estate showing pressure on 1W performance.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CSCO ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%), PM ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.89% | 1M: +21.36%), F ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.14% | 1M: +9.07%). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTC CORRECTION (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%), SHOP BELOW TREND (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%), CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.38% | 1M: -40.53%), CRH BELOW TREND (1W: -8.94% | 1M: -9.42%), BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%). Weakness concentrated in select high-volatility and discretionary names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: CSCO ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.43% | 1M: +4.84%). Major divergence present: multiple large-cap techs show 1W weakness vs strong 1M gains (AMD, QCOM, INTC in CORRECTION), so treat momentum moves as tactical.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed-to-uneven: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.45% | 1M: +14.09%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +0.39%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.70% | 1M: +13.60%) while INTC CORRECTION (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) and SHOP BELOW TREND (1W: -9.17% | 1M: -21.00%) show short-term splits; sector 1W is slightly negative.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed-to-weak: V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +3.59%) but JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.92%) and MA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.26% | 1M: -4.69%); Financials 1W: -0.30% and lack consistent leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Relatively constructive: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%), JNJ RECOVERY (1W: +2.44% | 1M: -3.34%)—sector showing defensive and selective strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and selective Healthcare exposure given clear 1W leadership (XOM ABOVE TREND, UNH ABOVE TREND, LLY ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to lagging Utilities and discretionary names showing confirmed weakness (CEG BELOW TREND, HD BELOW TREND). Given NEUTRAL regime and broad leadership, stay selective and monitor tech large-cap CORRECTIONs for tactical entries.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CSCO ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.41% | 1M: +39.89%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.81% | 1M: +45.43%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%). BEARISH: BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%), CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -9.38% | 1M: -40.53%), HD BELOW TREND (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -11.76%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +5.82%) given multiple energy names ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -5.80%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -3.03%) where earnings/news and guidance are pressuring names.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch continuation vs exhaustion in top 1W movers (CSCO, PANW) for follow-through; monitor whether INTC, AMD, QCOM sustain CORRECTION momentum (1W weakness vs 1M strength) as trigger for rotation. Track XOM and OXY holding ABOVE TREND to confirm energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+60): Eli Lilly; price confirming sentiment — LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.14% | 1M: +11.36%). CEG (+80): Constellation Energy; news bullish but price diverging — CEG BELOW TREND (1W: -11.86% | 1M: -10.54%) so watch for distribution. (Other high-sentiment names flagged in dataset; monitor for price confirmation.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
BKNG (-55): Booking Holdings; guidance cut and higher debt, price confirming — BKNG BELOW TREND (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -16.49%). HD (-40): Home Depot; negative sentiment aligns with price — HD BELOW TREND (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -11.76%). Monitor GILD and UNP in news list for follow-through on bearish catalysts.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +24.48%) and XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +4.61%) are showing relative strength while INTC CORRECTION (1W: -12.93% | 1M: +58.79%) and multiple tech names display short-term divergence; watch news-confirmed names like LLY ABOVE TREND (sentiment confirmed) and CEG BELOW TREND (sentiment-price divergence).
